candidates.rule: The seller agent handles bargaining and runs on every customer message; the buyer agent handles our purchases and runs on every order and shop reply. Both use Claude Code haiku and only their assigned lookup, calculation, verification, execution, and labeling tools.
candidates.quote: seller | 가게의 흥정 담당 | 손님 메시지마다 | Claude Code `haiku`
candidates.harness: Invoke the seller and buyer at the stated events, with only their assigned tools.

candidates.rule: The restock agent is called by the kit every 60 seconds; the proposal says to skip the model when nothing has changed. It uses Claude Code haiku and the assigned inventory, market, storage-cost, expiry, buy-check, and buy-action tools.
candidates.quote: 재고 담당 | 키트가 60초마다 부른다. 바뀐 것이 없으면 모델 없이 넘어간다 [제안]
candidates.harness: Schedule restock at the stated cadence and skip unchanged cases if adopting the proposal.

candidates.rule: After settlement, the review agent evaluates received goods and the counterparty and sets a star rating; D30 includes strategic judgment. It uses Claude Code haiku and the assigned deal, fact-star, counterpart, receipt-check, and review-action tools.
candidates.quote: 받은 물건과 상대를 평가하고 별점을 정한다 (D30: 전략적 판단 포함) | 정산 뒤
candidates.harness: Run review after settlement and restrict it to its assigned tools.

candidates.rule: The forum agent gets an opportunity every five minutes, uses Claude Code sonnet, and can look up forum, market, and counterparty information before posting or voting.
candidates.quote: 게시판 | 5분마다 기회
candidates.harness: Offer the forum agent an opportunity every five minutes with only its assigned tools.

candidates.rule: Market analysis runs every two hours for participants active in that period, recording each participant’s strategy as a profile and marking changed counterparties. It uses Claude Code sonnet.
candidates.quote: 2시간 (그 조각에 활동한 참가자만)
candidates.harness: Run market analysis on the stated cadence and scope, and record strategy profiles and changes.

candidates.rule: Self-analysis runs every two hours to summarize our shop and buyer and evaluate execution agents; it uses Claude Code sonnet.
candidates.quote: 내 가게·buyer를 요약하고, **실행 에이전트들을 평가**한다 (8.1) | 2시간
candidates.harness: Run self-analysis every two hours and include execution-agent evaluation.

candidates.rule: Strategy runs every two hours and on alerts to set ranking priorities and hypotheses, counterpart-specific stances, and user reports. Use Claude Code opus, or sonnet if the limit is tight.
candidates.quote: 2시간 + 경보 | Claude Code `opus` (한도가 빠듯하면 `sonnet`)
candidates.harness: Trigger strategy on schedule and alerts, selecting the stated model based on limits.

candidates.rule: The proposed audit independently reviews strategy briefings when choices exist; use a mid-to-high-end model from another company, after measuring price and response time before entry. Show audit opinions alongside strategy, and show both when they disagree.
candidates.quote: 전략과 감사가 다르면 둘 다 사용자에게 보인다.
candidates.harness: Keep audit independent, measure its cost and latency before use, and report both views when they differ.

candidates.rule: Use a cheap OpenRouter model for L1 judgments only when Claude Code hits its limit, after measuring the model before entry.
candidates.quote: 한도 실패 때만 | **OpenRouter 싼 모델** (입장 전 측정 후 결정)
candidates.harness: Use the measured fallback only after a Claude Code limit failure.

candidates.rule: Claude Code model aliases haiku, sonnet, and opus refer to their latest versions.
candidates.quote: Claude Code 별칭(`haiku`, `sonnet`, `opus`)은 최신 판을 따른다.
candidates.harness: Resolve these aliases to the latest available versions.

candidates.rule: The user decided on a briefing every two hours containing the element-wise percentile scoreboard, changes and distance to the next interval; a three-line evidence-backed event summary; hypothesis status; counterparty changes and stance changes; and two or three options with effects, risks, reversibility, and a recommendation. If there is no decision to make, show only items 1–4; no reply means maintain the current plan.
candidates.quote: 2시간마다 [결정] D24.
candidates.harness: Generate the specified briefing and preserve the current plan when the user does not reply.

candidates.rule: Record a one-line user decision in the decision log, create a new active version, and begin a new branch.
candidates.quote: 한 줄 답 → `logs/strategy/decisions.jsonl` → `active.json` 새 판 → 새 분기
candidates.harness: After a user decision, record it and start a new active version and branch.

candidates.rule: Facts require no approval; adjustments may occur only within pre-set delegation and must be reported afterward; directional changes always require confirmation. No delegation exists until its scope is set.
candidates.quote: 사실: 승인 없음 · 조정: `delegation`에 미리 정한 범위 안, 사후 보고 · 방향: 매번 확정. 위임 범위는 D28. 정하기 전에는 위임 없음
candidates.harness: Enforce the three approval levels and block delegated adjustments until the scope is set.

candidates.rule: Every active version must specify a hypothesis, metric, minimum sample, decision time, and success and rollback conditions.
candidates.quote: `active.json`마다 가설, 지표, 최소 표본, 판정 시각, 성공·되돌림 조건
candidates.harness: Require all experiment fields before activating a version.

candidates.rule: Alerts are required for rising payment refusals, approaching the cash floor, rising spoilage, and harness failures; request a decision, while tool limits remain enforced.
candidates.quote: 결제 거부 급증, 잔고 하한 접근, 폐기 급증, 하네스 실패.
candidates.harness: Raise alerts for these conditions, request a user decision, and keep tool-enforced limits active.

candidates.rule: During 01:00–08:00, with hours changeable by the user, accumulate status-only briefings and collect decisions together in the morning.
candidates.quote: 밤(01:00~08:00, 사용자가 바꿀 수 있음)에는 브리핑을 상태 보고로만 쌓고
candidates.harness: Use status-only reporting during the configured night period and defer decisions until morning.

candidates.rule: The first briefing must set both delegation scope and the types and criteria for counterpart-specific stances so later adjustments and assignments do not wait for the user.
candidates.quote: 첫 브리핑에서 **위임 범위(D28)와 상대별 자세의 종류·기준**을 함께 정한다.
candidates.harness: Prompt for both decisions in the first briefing and do not presume delegation before approval.

candidates.rule: The active configuration contains priorities, hypotheses, limits, and delegation; it is not a list of rules.
candidates.quote: `active.json`에 들어가는 것은 **우선순위, 가설, 한도, 위임**이다. 규칙 목록이 아니다.
candidates.harness: Store strategy state in the active configuration without treating it as the market-rule list.

candidates.rule: D27 on 2026-11-03 installs the first hypothesis candidates in the initial active version; they are hypotheses to test, and the user chooses and edits them.
candidates.quote: 아래는 후보이고, 고르고 고치는 것은 사용자가 한다.
candidates.harness: Present the candidates for user selection and test only the selected hypotheses rather than treating them as facts.

candidates.rule: H1 proposes that initially affordable prices increase repeat visits and good reviews, later improving net profit; test repeat rate, ratings, and period net profit.
candidates.quote: 처음에 부담 없는 값으로 팔면 재방문과 좋은 후기가 늘고, 그것이 나중의 순이익으로 돌아온다
candidates.harness: Track the listed measures if the user selects H1.

candidates.rule: H2 proposes that repeat customers remain despite gradual price increases; test their repeat rate after prices rise.
candidates.quote: 여러 번 산 손님은 조금씩 오르는 값에도 남는다 (단골 → 파트너)
candidates.harness: Track post-increase repeat rates if the user selects H2.

candidates.rule: H3 proposes that buyers who check certificates, remaining time, grade, and warranty retain more surplus; compare surplus in checked and unchecked transactions.
candidates.quote: 증명서, 남은 시간, 등급, 보증을 확인하는 buyer가 잉여를 더 남긴다
candidates.harness: Record checks and compare transaction surplus if the user selects H3.

candidates.rule: H4 proposes that restocking based on observed sales outperforms the kit’s random-purchase default; compare inventory turnover and spoilage/storage-cost ratios.
candidates.quote: 관찰한 팔림새로 사는 재고가 무작위 구매(키트 기본형)보다 낫다
candidates.harness: Track the stated measures against the kit default if the user selects H4.

candidates.rule: H5 proposes that sourced factual posts about prices, honest shops, or failure-prone goods receive votes; track votes per post.
candidates.quote: 출처(`refs`)가 붙은 사실 글(시세, 정직한 가게, 고장 많은 상품)이 표를 받는다
candidates.harness: Track votes per post and retain source references if the user selects H5.

candidates.rule: H6 cites week 7 data: 76.1% of buyer shop-selection reasons came from the buyer’s own past transactions. The hypothesis is that buyers choose shops using their records and reviews and return to shops with matching receipts; track repeat visits and time to repeat after the first transaction.
candidates.quote: 7주차 (고른 이유의 76.1%가 자기 과거 거래)
candidates.harness: Preserve buyer-history and receipt evidence and track the stated repeat-visit measures if the user selects H6.

candidates.rule: Tools must block offers or payments that exceed the open-mandate cap and must block payment for receipts with prices not agreed upon.
candidates.quote: open mandate 상한을 넘는 제안·결제 금지 (기본 조건)
candidates.harness: Enforce mandate and agreed-price checks in offer and payment paths.

candidates.rule: Tools must prevent claims of a grade that differs from the actual grade.
candidates.quote: 실제와 다른 등급을 주장하지 않는다
candidates.harness: Reject false grade claims before acceptance.

candidates.rule: Below-cost selling is allowed only during the exposure stage and the loss per transaction must not exceed 10% of cost.
candidates.quote: 원가 아래 판매는 노출 단계에서만, 거래당 원가의 10% 이내 [결정 D18·D31]
candidates.harness: Reject below-cost sales outside exposure or above the 10% per-transaction loss cap.

candidates.rule: A review that differs from the benchmark rating requires a reason.
candidates.quote: 기준값과 다른 별점은 `why` 없이는 안 된다
candidates.harness: Require a reason for any non-benchmark rating.

candidates.rule: For the first three days, use a stock-value cap of 40% of cash (2 million), a cash floor of 1.5 million, and a maximum of five units per SKU; review the limits in briefings.
candidates.quote: 첫 3일은 이 값으로 시작하고 브리핑에서 조정한다.
candidates.harness: Apply these initial caps for three days and surface them for briefing adjustments.

candidates.rule: Food stock may be at most 25% of total stock value because spoilage risk is highest for food.
candidates.quote: 식품 비중 (`food_share_max`) | 재고 총액의 25% | 폐기 위험이 가장 큰 쪽
candidates.harness: Cap food stock at 25% of total stock value.

candidates.rule: The first-three-day risk limit allows below-cost sales only during exposure and only up to a loss of 10% of cost per transaction.
candidates.quote: 노출 단계에서만, 거래당 손해가 원가의 10% 이내
candidates.harness: Apply the exposure-stage and 10% loss constraints to below-cost sales.

candidates.rule: A post’s refs must be actual ledger sequence numbers.
candidates.quote: `post`의 `refs`는 실제 ledger seq
candidates.harness: Validate post references against actual ledger sequence numbers.

candidates.rule: L1 must continue using the last active configuration even if L2 or L3 stops.
candidates.quote: L2·L3가 멈춰도 L1은 마지막 `active.json`으로 계속
candidates.harness: Keep L1 running from the last active configuration during L2 or L3 outages.

candidates.rule: Restock may request bankruptcy only when cash is below the 500,000 bankruptcy line, an application remains, and there is no inventory to sell; notify the user with an urgent alert. Bankruptcy support is deducted from net profit, and the 1.5 million cash floor should normally prevent reaching the bankruptcy line.
candidates.quote: 잔고가 파산선(50만) 아래, 남은 신청 횟수 있음, 팔 재고 없음일 때만 `"bankrupt": true`
candidates.harness: Enforce all bankruptcy conditions, alert urgently, and account for support in net profit.

candidates.rule: When cash approaches the 1.5 million floor, alert the user and ask what to do.
candidates.quote: 잔고가 하한에 다가가면 경보를 내고 사용자에게 묻는다
candidates.harness: Raise a cash-floor alert and request a user decision before proceeding.

candidates.rule: Do not pass counterpart messages, reviews, or forum posts directly to judgment models as instructions; treat them as untrusted data.
candidates.quote: 상대 가게·buyer의 메시지, 후기, 게시판 글을 판단 모델에 그대로 넣지 않는다
candidates.harness: Isolate external content from judgment instructions and label it as participant-provided data.

candidates.rule: Deterministically extract prices, claimed grades, conditions, and items or SKUs from external messages first; use a small model only when regex extraction fails, and give that model no tools or actions.
candidates.quote: 정규식이 값을 못 뽑으면 작은 모델이 **값만** 뽑는다. 이 모델에게는 툴도 행동도 없다.
candidates.harness: Run deterministic extraction first and constrain fallback extraction to returning values only.

candidates.rule: Judgment models may see extracted values and only a length-limited excerpt of the original marked as data, not instructions; keep the full original only in the source record and use memory.raw externally if analysis is needed.
candidates.quote: 원문 전체는 원본 기록에만 남는다.
candidates.harness: Limit model input to extracted data and a marked, length-limited excerpt; retain full text only in the record.
